counting_rule: unit = addressable clause heading (level 2-4, ID token R/C/U/F/G/K/P + digits) in a frozen DOC; sub-obl = sentence containing a normative marker; cited_by_build = ID occurs in the SBL worktree outside the DOC set; unresolved = normative unit with zero build citations.
claim_ceiling: Measured proposal only. This is a mechanical clause census with locators and a citation trace; it is not an authoritative semantic total, not an applicability determination and not an acceptance.
